questions.notes: SUB-POPULATION POLL: respondents are reservists only (served 20+ days). The seat column is explicitly 'חישוב מנדטים בתרחיש בו רק משרתי מילואים יצביעו' - a hypothetical seat calculation if only reservists voted; NOT a national forecast. pct is of the whole reservist sample (includes undecided 17%, other 6%, not voting 2%). Parties with blank seat cell are below threshold in this scenario -> seats 0. רע"ם not listed. בל"ד separate -> אחר.

extraction_notes: Dialog poll for Yedioth/ynet among reserve soldiers (20+ days), dated 21/08/2026; fieldwork 17-19/08/2026, internet panel. 4,013 asked, 509 responded (12%), 3,504 refused (88%). Planned initial sample 500. Questions 1-6 (reserve days, conscription policy for Haredim/Arabs, government treatment of reservists, influence on vote) are not vote-intention - ignored. Only Q7 extracted; marked 'main' but it is a sector-only poll and seats are a reservists-only scenario.
